recipes.name: Quick Tofu Tikka Masala
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pan over high heat. Cook the tofu, turning periodically, until golden on all sides.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a sauté pan pan over medium-high heat. Cook the onion for 3 minutes.
Add the ginger and mustard seeds. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Add the masala seasoning, salt, and chili and toast for another minute. The dish is spicy, so omit or add less chili if you're not a fan of heat.
Add the chopped tomato, cooking cream, yogurt, cashews, and tomato paste. Cook for 7 to 8 minutes.
Lastly, add the cooked tofu and stir it through.
Squeeze over the lime juice, stir, and serve with naan or rice. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † We use pure ground chili powder made from dried chili peppers - not to be confused with the chili powder spice blend commonly found in the US, which often includes cumin, garlic powder, and other seasonings. For the intended heat and flavour, be sure to use pure chili powder.
Storage Keep in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days.
